    <g transform="translate(18,18)">
      <text x="0" y="0" font-family="Inter" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#161C35">Privacy Statement Summary</text>
      <text x="0" y="28" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#525467">1. Acceptance of terms</text>
      <text x="0" y="48" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">By accessing or using Expedia services, you agree to be</text>
      <text x="0" y="66" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">bound by these Terms and any related policies.</text>
      <text x="0" y="92" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#525467">2. Use of the website</text>
      <text x="0" y="112" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">You may browse, book, and manage travel arrangements</text>
      <text x="0" y="130" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">for lawful personal or business purposes only.</text>
      <text x="0" y="156" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#525467">3. Account responsibility</text>
      <text x="0" y="176" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of</text>
      <text x="0" y="194" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">your account credentials and all activity under your login.</text>
      <text x="0" y="220" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#525467">4. Payments and fees</text>
      <text x="0" y="240" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">Prices, taxes, service fees, and cancellation rules may</text>
      <text x="0" y="258" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">change based on supplier policies and availability.</text>
      <text x="0" y="284" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#525467">5. Privacy and communications</text>
      <text x="0" y="304" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">We may send booking confirmations, reminders, updates,</text>
      <text x="0" y="322" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">and promotional messages according to your preferences.</text>
      <text x="0" y="348" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#525467">6. Content and conduct</text>
      <text x="0" y="368" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">Do not submit unlawful, abusive, or misleading content,</text>
      <text x="0" y="386" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">and do not interfere with the site or its security.</text>
      <text x="0" y="412" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#525467">7. Liability</text>
      <text x="0" y="432" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">Expedia acts as an intermediary between travelers and</text>
      <text x="0" y="450" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">travel suppliers and may limit liability where permitted.</text>
      <text x="0" y="476" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#525467">8. Changes to these terms</text>
      <text x="0" y="496" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">We may revise these terms from time to time. Continued</text>
      <text x="0" y="514" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">use after updates means you accept the revised terms.</text>
